messages:
mike: FYI customer request — they want BYOK but with a twist: delegated KMS shards per-account across us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1. they expect independent keys per shard and cross-region failover. need recommendations on RBAC, audit trails, and emergency access.

anya: do they want full split-key (threshold HSM) or just separate KMS CMKs per shard? huge difference for ops.

jordan: leaning toward per-account CMKs that are region-scoped + a lightweight escrow for emergency unsealing. avoids complex threshold crypto for now.

mike: yes, customer prefers not to manage threshold HSM initially. wants auditability + clear custody boundaries.

olivia: compliance note — for SOC2 / PCI customers we need documented attestation that keys are under customer control and that we can produce audit logs (immutable) for 7 years. verify retention and tamper-evidence.

anya: propose model: each account has 3 CMKs (one per region). We provision a redwood-managed proxy role that can call kms:GenerateDataKey and kms:Decrypt only when allowed by customer IAM bindings. access is granted via cross-account IAM role that the customer trusts.

jordan: example policy sketch (very simplified):

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abcd...","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"aws:PrincipalAccount":"customer-acc"}}}
  ]
}
```

anya: that Condition is lightweight — we'll need to add IAM role ARNs or cross-account trust for stricter scoping. also log entries must include principal, role session name, operation, and request parameters.

sec-bot: automated-scan: flagged use of long-lived cross-account roles in project/redwood-byok. recommend ephemeral STS sessions + access reviews. :warning:

mike: agreed — ephemeral creds only. we should use AssumeRole with external ID + role session name containing account-id and requestor.

olivia: and record the external ID and approval flow in the audit log. for regulated customers we need an approval artifact (ticket/ok) stored with the request id.

jordan: operational concerns — rotation. If a customer rotates their CMKs, what happens to stored model caches encrypted with old keys? need rewrap path or fallback.

anya: rewrap plan: have a background job that fetches encrypted blobs, calls kms:Decrypt with old key then kms:Encrypt with new. must be rate-limited and respect SLOs. also provide a graceful fallback: route to legacy key if rewrap in-progress.

sre-oncall: incident mode questions — in a partial-region outage, can we failover to a different region's CMK? customer contract may or may not allow cross-region decryption. need explicit opt-in and legal signoff.

mike: capture that: default = no cross-region decryption; opt-in = replicated CMKs with customer consent. document in onboarding checklist.

olivia: also document audit retention endpoint and prove chain-of-custody for key import. customers will ask for HSM import attestation (key fingerprint, import token).

jordan: vuln triage: saw a CVE in a third-party KMS SDK (lib-kms 2.1.3). we should run dependency SBOM and patch; meanwhile, block unmanaged client uploads and require server-side signing.

anya: actionable items: 1) draft RBAC pattern for cross-account AssumeRole + minimal kms actions, 2) audit schema for BYOK requests (fields + retention), 3) emergency escrow workflow and opt-in for cross-region decrypt, 4) rotation/rewrap runbook, 5) patch lib-kms and send advisory.

mike: assigning: anya -> RBAC & policy examples; olivia -> compliance artifacts + onboarding checklist; jordan -> rewrap runbook + SDK patch verification; sre-oncall -> failover playbook + DR constraints. i'll prepare a short PRD for PM review.

sec-bot: created ticket SECBOT-4921 for lib-kms upgrade and SECBOT-4922 for BYOK audit schema. :white_check_mark:

mike: thanks all — let's sync tomorrow 10am PT. if anyone hits a blocker before then ping me or @sec-oncall. :thumbsup:
